title: Chapter 7113: Where Are You From?

Chapter 7113: Where Are You From?

Chapter 7113: Where Are You From?

“Yes, I came from the outside.” Li Qiye nodded.

“The other firmament?!” Her expression changed.

Was he from another firmament or the outside world? Another firmament meant he could be aiming for them.

After all, Chongming Immortal Lord was sealed without warning. Dragon servants such as themselves had no idea what was going on. Even their leader, Sacred Stone Immortal, was caught off guard.

This development was unprecedented for Divine Firmament, signalling a great and torrential change. All along, the shift in rulers was peaceful due to the divine beasts’ solidarity.

Today, the dragon servants felt an internal conflict brewing. They were loyal to the chongming birds and must fight to the bitter end.

“From outside your world.” Li Qiye smiled.

She heaved a sigh of relief upon hearing this. This was better than the alternative.

“Which world are you from? Grand Thousand or Mortal?” She asked, having no idea about Mortal World’s demise. She only heard about them from her seniors.

“Neither, I am from the nine worlds.” He said.

“Never heard of it.” She took a second before responding.

“Not surprising, just a small place.” Li Qiye smiled.

“You have to take a trip to the divine realm with me.” Her alertness dropped after hearing about his origin.

“Why is that?” He asked.

“First, we have to investigate you.” She said: “But most importantly, you have to return Our Highness.”

“It’s not my fault that it wants to stay with me.” Li Qiye shook his head.

“Either way, do not resist.” She said.

“I don’t like being ordered around and always do the opposite.” Li Qiye said.

“We’ll see if you have the ability to do so.” She said.

“I’m afraid this world can’t accurately assess my ability.” He smiled.

“Is that so? Get ready and take this!” She warned before attacking.

“Screech!” A golden phoenix manifested into reality and soared for Li Qiye.

Its wings could cut through mountains. Fiery sparks splashed everywhere upon hitting Li Qiye. However, the result shocked her.

She thought her move was dangerous enough to force him to use his true power or treasure. Alas, he didn’t move at all, being completely impervious to the attack.

“You’re no match for me.” Li Qiye said and flicked one finger, sending her flying like a helpless fly.

She rolled on the ground and vomited blood once she got up. She realized she was facing a monster and fled to warn the others.

“What’s the hurry?” He raised his hand, immobilizing and pulling her back like a chicken.

“Wha-what do you want?!” She shouted.

“Don’t worry, I won’t roast and eat you.” He smiled.

She turned pale, realizing the immense gap in power.
